gates.title: Correctness
gates.failure: Unsupported or stale claims reach acceptance

gates.title: Authority
gates.failure: Unauthorized tool action or data crossing

gates.title: Recovery
gates.failure: Lost work or duplicated irreversible effect

gates.title: Experience
gates.failure: Core decision or export cannot be completed

gates.title: Customer value
gates.failure: Cost omits failed attempts or correction

gates.title: Provider consumption
gates.failure: External usage or credits counted twice

gates.title: Ownership

metrics.definition: Accepted customer tasks / all eligible initiated customer tasks
metrics.denominator: All eligible initiated tasks; abandoned tasks remain in the denominator; retries counted in cost rather than as new tasks

metrics.definition: Unsupported material claims / material claims inspected
metrics.target: Proposed hard gate: 0 accepted unsupported material claims

metrics.definition: Denied forbidden actions / attempted forbidden actions
metrics.target: Hard gate: all specified forbidden actions denied

metrics.definition: Jobs recovered without lost work / injected interrupted jobs
metrics.denominator: Jobs interrupted at specified persistence boundaries
metrics.target: Proposed hard gate: all scoped interruption cases recover

metrics.definition: Duplicate external effects / replayed effect attempts
Median and p95 elapsed time from entry to accepted artifact
metrics.denominator: Consenting pilot starters; failures recorded separately
metrics.target: Proposed: median <= 45 minutes for the first bounded lab

metrics.definition: Unaided accepted completions / consenting pilot starters
Critical tasks completed using keyboard and narrow viewport
metrics.target: Hard gate: all core tasks usable; no critical accessibility findings

metrics.definition: p75 LCP / INP / CLS on actual devices
metrics.denominator: Real-user page views by device class; lab results separate
metrics.target: Proposed: LCP <= 2.5 s, INP <= 200 ms, CLS <= 0.1

metrics.definition: All-attempt inference + hosting + review + support cost / accepted outputs
metrics.denominator: Accepted outputs in same period and currency

metrics.definition: Observed redeployed capacity or financial value minus full delivery cost
metrics.denominator: Consenting eligible customer tasks with comparable baseline
metrics.target: Proposed: positive after correction and adoption; capacity is not revenue

metrics.definition: Attributed billable provider cost reconciled to invoices
metrics.denominator: Selected account/service/region billable usage; net of credits
metrics.target: Proposed: reconcile within agreed tolerance; no duplicated external API cost

metrics.definition: Equivalent restored projects / exported test projects
metrics.denominator: All specified export/import fixtures and a clean host
metrics.target: Hard gate: all scoped restores reproduce owned artifacts

metrics.definition: Records past review_by / required source records
metrics.denominator: Sources affecting current public claims and executable templates
metrics.window: Release and scheduled existing controller review
metrics.target: Hard gate: 0 overdue required volatile sources

metrics.definition: Broken or unresolved required locators / required locators inspected
metrics.denominator: Public source and product links; auth walls classified separately
metrics.target: Hard gate: broken required links fixed or explicitly held

metrics.definition: Resolved blocking findings / blocking findings raised
metrics.target: Hard gate: all blockers disposed; author approval separate
